status_definitions.VALIDATED: Empirical evidence demonstrates economically meaningful incremental value over a simpler baseline.
status_definitions.RESEARCH_ONLY: Experimental and prohibited from affecting production decisions, sizing, reports, or email.
status_definitions.REJECTED: Tested and not worth its incremental complexity.
status_definitions.CORE_RISK_CONTROL: Primarily protects operational safety; this is not an alpha-validation claim.
status_definitions.UNASSESSED: Evidence is missing or insufficient; existing production presence is not validation.

filters.name: Stage 2 structure
filters.production_effect: Candidate discovery gate before the canonical final decision.
filters.evidence_summary: Implemented; no repository evidence establishes incremental out-of-sample value.
filters.notes: Do not infer validation from production presence.

filters.name: Recent relative strength
filters.production_effect: Primary-edge gate and ranking input; missing or sufficiently weak values block actionability.
filters.evidence_summary: A survivorship-biased 2017-2023 engineering discovery found the fixed >=70 rule worse than MODEL_0; this is not validation evidence.
filters.discovery_result: 263 capacity-limited trades; expectancy 0.216R versus 0.348R baseline; profit factor 1.402 versus 1.644; maximum drawdown 29.281R versus 22.284R.
filters.notes: Remain UNASSESSED. Requires independent point-in-time validation; do not change production from the biased discovery result.

filters.name: Long-term relative strength
filters.production_effect: Candidate scoring, ordering, and leadership context.
filters.evidence_summary: A survivorship-biased 2017-2023 engineering discovery found the fixed >=75 rule worse than MODEL_0; this is not validation evidence.
filters.discovery_result: 278 capacity-limited trades; expectancy 0.280R versus 0.348R baseline; profit factor 1.484 versus 1.644; maximum drawdown 25.516R versus 22.284R.
filters.notes: Remain UNASSESSED. Test jointly with Recent RS using independent point-in-time data.

filters.name: Market regime
filters.production_effect: Controls new-risk permission and heat and contributes market context.
filters.evidence_summary: Operational behavior is tested; incremental expectancy/drawdown evidence for the model is not recorded.
filters.notes: Risk purpose does not automatically validate current regime thresholds.

filters.name: Industry qualification
filters.production_effect: Secondary confirmation and ranking; incomplete coverage cannot silently grant confirmation.
filters.evidence_summary: Synthetic ranking invariants exist; no out-of-sample trade ablation is recorded.
filters.notes: Historical point-in-time classification coverage is a known limitation.

filters.name: Sister-stock confirmation
filters.production_effect: Secondary confirmation that may reduce FULL to HALF but cannot repair failed primary edge.
filters.evidence_summary: A survivorship-biased 2017-2023 engineering discovery found little incremental value for the fixed >=0.30 rule; this is not validation evidence.
filters.discovery_result: 261 capacity-limited trades; expectancy 0.317R versus 0.348R baseline; profit factor 1.576 versus 1.644; maximum drawdown unchanged at 22.284R.
filters.notes: Requires point-in-time industry membership and breadth.

filters.name: Setup tightness
filters.production_effect: Contributes setup integrity, category consistency, ranking, and actionability.
filters.evidence_summary: Semantic behavior is tested; no empirical expectancy delta is recorded.
filters.notes: Test with VCP and pullback features for correlated complexity.

filters.name: VCP quality
filters.production_effect: Contributes setup integrity and ranking.
filters.evidence_summary: No controlled ablation result is recorded.
filters.notes: Measure interaction with tightness before promotion or removal.

filters.name: Pullback quality
filters.production_effect: Contributes setup integrity, category ordering, and report ranking.
filters.evidence_summary: No controlled ablation result is recorded.
filters.notes: Evaluate both alpha and trade-frequency effects.

filters.name: Volume confirmation
filters.production_effect: Secondary confirmation that may reduce FULL to HALF.
filters.evidence_summary: No controlled ablation result is recorded.
filters.notes: Remain UNASSESSED. Test threshold stability and interaction with setup type on independent data.

filters.name: Structural reward/risk
filters.production_effect: A valid observed target and configured minimum structural R/R are hard actionability gates.
filters.evidence_summary: Risk semantics are invariant-tested; the threshold lacks recorded out-of-sample ablation evidence.
filters.notes: Synthetic model targets cannot masquerade as observed resistance.

filters.name: Distance from pivot
filters.production_effect: Contributes entry timing and ranking.
filters.evidence_summary: No controlled ablation result is recorded.
filters.notes: Requires an observable point-in-time pivot definition.

filters.name: Entry timing
filters.production_effect: Blocks overextended entries and can reduce otherwise valid setups from FULL to HALF.
filters.evidence_summary: A survivorship-biased engineering proxy test of the current EMA/high extension limits reduced drawdown but not expectancy; detailed entry timing remains untested.
filters.discovery_result: 255 capacity-limited trades; expectancy 0.324R versus 0.348R baseline; maximum drawdown 18.276R versus 22.284R.
filters.notes: Remain UNASSESSED. This was only an extension-limit proxy with next-session execution, not the full entry-timing state machine.

filters.name: Exclude low-beta stocks
filters.production_effect: NONE; requested hypothesis only.
filters.evidence_summary: A fixed rolling-beta >=0.8 rule underperformed both before and after applying the mandatory earnings blackout.
filters.discovery_result: With the earnings blackout: 281 capacity-limited trades; expectancy 0.118R versus 0.350R baseline; profit factor 1.192 versus 1.653; maximum drawdown 28.57R versus 21.64R.
filters.notes: Do not promote as an alpha rule. Beta used 126 sessions through the signal date; the user's preference may remain a portfolio mandate, but independent validation is unavailable.

filters.name: Exclude Utilities sector
filters.production_effect: NONE; requested hypothesis only.
filters.evidence_summary: The earlier apparent benefit from excluding Utilities reversed after applying the mandatory earnings blackout; classifications remain current rather than effective-dated.
filters.discovery_result: With the earnings blackout: 267 capacity-limited trades; expectancy 0.263R versus 0.350R baseline; profit factor 1.456 versus 1.653; maximum drawdown 34.02R versus 21.64R.
filters.notes: Unstable adaptive evidence; do not promote as alpha. The user's no-Utilities preference may remain a mandate, but research requires effective-dated sector classification and independent validation.

filters.name: ATR initial stops and fixed-R profit targets
filters.production_effect: NONE; requested 20-combination research grid only.
filters.evidence_summary: All fixed 2R/2.5R/3R targets and ATR-based initial stops underperformed the no-target/20-day-low baseline in survivorship-biased discovery.
filters.discovery_result: The baseline retained 259 capacity-limited trades at 0.348R expectancy, 1.644 profit factor, and 22.284R maximum drawdown. The best non-baseline expectancy was 0.242R; fixed-target variants ranged from -0.082R to 0.062R. No combination met the preregistered shortlist gate.
filters.notes: Keep research-only. All 20 cells reused one current-universe discovery sample. A later boundary audit found early-2024 price use by late-2023 outcomes, so early 2024 is contaminated for this version; independent point-in-time validation is unavailable.

filters.name: Combined exits, stops, and portfolio exposure
filters.production_effect: NONE; full 180-cell discovery cross only.
filters.evidence_summary: One of 180 preregistered cells passed the absolute discovery gate, but it was a complex isolated target optimum with weak later-period performance.
filters.discovery_result: The 20-day-low stop, 2R target, earned-2R plus 2R/4R/6R drawdown cell accepted 170 trades at 0.194R expectancy, 1.573 profit factor, 33.02% return, and 4.65% max daily MTM drawdown. Adjacent 2.5R/3R targets accepted only 31/43 trades and returned 0% in the later discovery period.
filters.notes: Remain RESEARCH_ONLY and HOLD. Multiple-testing, survivorship bias, low neighboring stability, and missing independent validation prohibit forward-strategy freeze or production promotion.

filters.name: Simple stop, exit, and exposure cross-validation
filters.production_effect: NONE; frozen 168-cell discovery, 2024 validation, and conditional 2025 holdout only.
filters.evidence_summary: The simple fixed-2R/20-day-low/40-session candidate passed discovery and the frozen 2024 validation, but failed the one-time 2025 holdout drawdown gate.
filters.discovery_result: 123 accepted trades; 72.96% return, 0.593R expectancy, 2.198 profit factor, and 6.97% maximum daily MTM drawdown.
filters.validation_result: 2024: 12 accepted trades; 6.74% return, 0.561R expectancy, 2.420 profit factor, and 4.03% maximum drawdown; frozen gate pass.
filters.holdout_result: 2025: 13 accepted trades; 26.94% return, 2.072R expectancy, 8.521 profit factor, and 13.29% maximum drawdown; frozen gate fail because drawdown exceeded 10%.
filters.notes: Remain RESEARCH_ONLY and HOLD. The archive is survivorship-biased, post-2023 accepted samples are small and path-dependent, and no combination proved the <=10% drawdown objective.

filters.name: Win-to-three, loss-to-two exposure discipline
filters.production_effect: NONE; adaptive robustness only.
filters.evidence_summary: The clarified 2R/3R state machine was highly unstable across reused periods and did not control development drawdown.
filters.discovery_result: Without earnings blackout in reused 2017-2023: 160 trades, 14.20% return, 0.089R expectancy, 1.151 profit factor, and 22.06% maximum drawdown versus fixed-2R 72.96% return and 6.97% drawdown.
filters.validation_result: Reused March 2024-October 2025, not independent: 37 trades, 19.56% return, 0.529R expectancy, 2.395 profit factor, and 6.93% maximum drawdown.
filters.notes: Remain RESEARCH_ONLY. It correctly never exceeded three positions but failed older-period risk stability; there is no untouched holdout.

filters.name: Repeated win-expand, loss-contract exposure staircase
filters.production_effect: NONE; adaptive robustness only.
filters.evidence_summary: All six 2R-start staircase variants failed the complete two-period gate because reused 2017-2023 maximum drawdown exceeded 10%.
filters.discovery_result: Reused 2017-2023: dynamic variants accepted 179-214 trades, returned 33.54%-83.11%, had 0.176R-0.464R expectancy and 1.293-1.802 profit factor, but reached 15.58%-16.59% maximum drawdown. Fixed 2R returned 42.78% with 9.75% drawdown.
filters.validation_result: Reused March 2024-October 2025, not independent: 4R STEP/RESET and 6R/8R RESET stayed below 10% drawdown, while 6R/8R STEP reached 12.91%. No dynamic rule passed both periods.
filters.notes: Remain RESEARCH_ONLY and HOLD. The fixed-2R earnings-blackout baseline was the only numeric two-period gate pass. Prices are survivorship-biased, earnings dates are retrospective, and there is no untouched holdout.

filters.name: Ten-calendar-day pre-earnings signal blackout
filters.production_effect: NONE; retrospective earnings-date proxy only.
filters.evidence_summary: The blackout is now enforced across 385 adaptive retest settings. It materially changed rankings but produced no robust two-period <=10% drawdown solution.
filters.discovery_result: The boundary-purged signal universe fell from 29,452 to 25,456. No 180-cell cross passed. Two simple fixed-2R/no-target cells passed development; filter effects, especially Utilities exclusion, were unstable.
filters.validation_result: Reused 2024 numeric gates passed for the 30- and 40-session fixed-2R candidates. Both failed reused 2025 at 12.86% and 13.07% maximum drawdown; these samples are REUSED_CONTAMINATED, not independent.
filters.notes: Keep as the user's mandatory research-universe constraint, not a validated alpha filter. Historical Yahoo event dates were retrieved retrospectively and may differ from schedules known on signal dates; production remains unchanged.

filters.name: SPY market entry and heat gate
filters.production_effect: NONE; SPY-only historical robustness cross.
filters.evidence_summary: The SPY-above-SMA50 gate was the only market-only policy to pass every reused stage gate, but it reduced later-period return and is not the production market-regime model.
filters.discovery_result: SPY above SMA50 with no trailing stop: 105 accepted trades, 58.21% return, 8.01% max drawdown, 0.554R expectancy, and 2.026 profit factor versus the unrestricted 42.78% / 9.75% / 0.345R / 1.691 baseline.
filters.validation_result: Reused/contaminated only. 2024 returned 9.59% with 4.54% drawdown versus 9.93% / 3.93% unrestricted; 2025 returned 6.58% with 5.95% drawdown versus 28.01% / 13.07% unrestricted.
filters.notes: Keep research-only and HOLD. It reduced 2025 risk largely by excluding the exceptional RGLD path. Full production-regime reconstruction requires additional point-in-time inputs.

filters.name: 2R/3R-activated SMA20 profit-protection stop
filters.production_effect: NONE; causal historical robustness cross.
filters.evidence_summary: Only the SPY-above-SMA50 plus 2R-activated SMA20-minus-1ATR20 rule improved its same-market no-trailing return in all three reused periods; nearby offsets were materially unstable.
filters.discovery_result: With the SMA50 gate, the 2R/SMA20-minus-1ATR20 rule accepted 104 trades and returned 65.63% with 7.54% drawdown, 0.631R expectancy, and 2.255 profit factor versus 58.21% / 8.01% / 0.554R / 2.026 without trailing protection.
filters.validation_result: Reused/contaminated only. The same rule returned 11.41% / 4.54% drawdown in 2024 and 8.81% / 3.98% in 2025; the matching no-trailing gate returned 9.59% / 4.54% and 6.58% / 5.95%.
filters.notes: Keep research-only and HOLD. Reused 2024 was dominated by one 10.22R winner, and the exact SMA20 neighbor returned only 0.43% with 11.99% development drawdown. No production or forward specification changed.

filters.name: Earn the right to expand exposure
filters.production_effect: NONE; requested portfolio-allocation hypothesis only.
filters.evidence_summary: Two permanent 2R-start ladders were tested in survivorship-biased discovery and did not keep daily mark-to-market drawdown below 10%.
filters.discovery_result: Both ladders unlocked 4R by 2017-03-03, selected the same 248 trades, returned 81.40%, and reached 16.97% maximum drawdown.
filters.notes: Do not promote. The permanent early-profit unlock did not control later-cycle exposure; a future redesign requires a new preregistered experiment.

filters.name: Critical data validity and freshness
filters.production_effect: Missing, stale, anomalous, or incomplete critical data blocks actionability or publication.
filters.evidence_summary: Classified for operational safety, not claimed alpha.
filters.notes: Covered by data-quality, regression, and semantic-invariant tests.

filters.name: Valid structural stop
filters.production_effect: Invalid or unavailable stops block actionability and sizing.
filters.evidence_summary: Classified for operational safety, not claimed alpha.
filters.notes: Covered by decision and report invariant tests.

filters.name: Portfolio heat and concentration
filters.production_effect: Caps total, industry, and theme risk and may block otherwise actionable candidates.
filters.evidence_summary: Classified for operational safety, not claimed alpha.
filters.notes: Covered by decision and production-integrity tests.

filters.name: Maximum simultaneous positions
filters.production_effect: Blocks new positions once the configured hard cap is reached.
filters.evidence_summary: A survivorship-biased allocation study found materially different return/drawdown trade-offs across fixed 1R to 4R heat; this calibrates risk but is not validation evidence.
filters.discovery_result: Fixed 4R selected 254 trades, returned 88.24%, and reached 20.31% daily MTM max drawdown. Fixed 2R selected 123 trades, returned 72.96%, and reached 6.97% max drawdown; it missed the 150-trade gate.
filters.notes: Remain CORE_RISK_CONTROL. Current configured default is four; the promising fixed-2R discovery requires independent validation and has not changed production.

filters.name: Drawdown risk modes
filters.production_effect: Reduces or stops new risk as account drawdown increases.
filters.evidence_summary: Survivorship-biased discovery showed that fixed-R drawdown stops reduced measured drawdown mainly by blocking new risk for most later sessions; current calibration is not empirically validated.
filters.discovery_result: The 2R/4R/6R overlay accepted 27 trades, returned 21.11%, reached 5.41% max drawdown, and blocked new risk for 1,482 sessions. The 3R/6R/9R overlay accepted 52 trades and blocked for 1,331 sessions.
filters.notes: Remain CORE_RISK_CONTROL. Separate correctness of enforcement from empirical calibration; no tested drawdown overlay passed the complete shortlist gate.
